title: Day and night
examples: Teacher, why do we have day and night?
Does the sun move around the Earth?
What makes it dark when the sun goes down?

explain.say: The Earth is always spinning. One whole spin takes one day. This spinning is called rotation.
The Sun is a huge ball of hot gas. It stays in its place while the Earth spins. The Sun only seems to move across the sky.

draw.text: The Sun stays; the Earth spins

explain.say: When your part of the Earth faces the Sun, it is daytime. You can see the sunlight.
When your part of the Earth turns away from the Sun, it is night. It is dark, and most people sleep.

faq.q: Why does the day and night happen?
faq.a: The Earth is always spinning. As it spins, different parts face the Sun.

faq.q: Does the Sun move across the sky?
faq.a: No. The Sun only seems to move. The Earth is spinning, so the Sun looks as if it crosses the sky.
asks: Does the Sun travel across the sky?

faq.q: What is the spinning motion called?
faq.a: The spinning of the Earth is called rotation. One spin takes one day.

faq.q: What happens when the Earth spins?
faq.a: When the Earth spins, the part facing the Sun has day. The part facing away has night.
asks: What is the result of spinning?

faq.q: Is the Sun moving around the Earth?
faq.a: No. The Earth goes around the Sun once a year. The Earth's spin gives us day and night.
asks: Where is the Sun in relation to Earth?

facts: The Earth spins on an imaginary line.
This spinning motion is called rotation.
It takes one full day for Earth to spin once.
Day happens when Earth faces the Sun.

options.show: the Sun moving across the sky
options.say: the Sun moving across the sky

quiz.why: The Earth spins, so each part faces the Sun, then turns away.

wrong.1: The Moon is too small to block the Sun every night.
wrong.2: The Sun only seems to move, because the Earth spins.

quiz.say: Your part of the Earth faces the Sun. What time is it?
quiz.why: Facing the Sun means sunlight reaches you. That is daytime.

wrong.0: Night comes when your part turns away from the Sun.
wrong.2: Winter is a season, and it has both days and nights.

quiz.say: How long does the Earth take to spin round once?
quiz.why: One whole spin takes one day and one night.

wrong.0: One hour is much too short for a whole spin.
wrong.1: A year is how long the Earth takes to go round the Sun.
